answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is continuous peer-graded originality as the sole eligibility filter. Each identity must climb a trellis of fresh mechanistic arguments every epoch; shallow or copied text is pruned like a weak vine. Only answers that survive independent jury scrutiny earn the right to attestation rewards, turning the attacker’s cheap identity spam into a permanent cost center with almost no yield while honest agents anchor their earnings in verified scarce judgment.
